captureMethod: Isolated browser; lossless PNG at 2× density. Original bytes copied unchanged; numbered arrows are a separate component layer.

captures.name: markets
captures.title: Markets before taking a seat
captures.alt: Hosted Owarine Markets in light theme, with the sky demo rail, a META Window and Take a seat.
captures.state: No leased seat. The rail shows guest paper credits. Public market data comes from the hosted DevNet venue.

annotations.label: Take a guest seat from the rail.

captures.name: seatMenu
captures.title: Your leased party and test funds
captures.alt: Hosted Owarine seat menu showing Guest seat 3, Party id, the copy button, lease time and 2,007.50 DevNet test credits.
captures.state: Guest seat 3 leased on Canton DevNet. The menu shows its party and test funds; the pink rail distinguishes this from the paper preview.

annotations.label: Copy the leased Canton party id.

captures.name: demoCredits
captures.title: Test Canton Coin deposited into credits
captures.alt: Hosted Add funds dialog after a 20 Canton Coin deposit, with 2,010.00 test credits and the displayed conversion rate of 0.125 credits per Canton Coin.
captures.state: A 200-test-Canton-Coin faucet request succeeded. A 20 CC deposit raised the displayed balance from 2,007.50 to 2,010.00 credits. No cash value.

captures.name: portfolioHistory
captures.title: A settled BTC call in History
captures.alt: Hosted Portfolio showing one BTC Up win, a 3.00-credit payout, net +2.15 and rail balance 2,012.15. A stale To collect label also remains visible.
captures.state: The recorded BTC two-minute Up call settled and the balance updated. The history row still showed a stale collection label; it was not removed from the capture.

captures.name: proofTimeline
captures.title: Signed oracle prints on a settled Window
captures.alt: Hosted Owarine proof page showing three exchange oracle prints at each boundary, medians, quorum, spread, outcome and resolver and venue signatories.
captures.state: A settled BTC two-minute Window on Canton DevNet. The proof links its ledger update; the linked projection showed its offset, UTC time and three witnessed events.

annotations.label: Inspect the recorded Coinbase print and its source hash.

captures.name: portfolioBalance
captures.title: Available credits and a held position
captures.alt: Hosted Owarine Portfolio after one BTC win, showing available test credits, an open five-minute position and separate pocket balances.
captures.state: One BTC two-minute call has paid automatically. Another BTC five-minute position remains open; the attempted sell-back did not confirm.

annotations.label: Read the balance alongside marked open positions.

captures.name: phone
captures.title: Markets on a phone
captures.alt: Hosted Owarine Markets at 390 by 844 CSS pixels, with the sky paper-credit header, Take a seat and bottom navigation.
captures.state: An anonymous phone-sized browser. The sky Demo chip marks paper credits; no second seat was leased.

annotations.label: Take a seat from the phone header.

captures.name: deskPractice
captures.title: A newly created practice desk
captures.alt: Hosted Owarine AI Labs practice desk showing a 1,000 dollar paper balance, target allocations and Waiting for its first check.
